launch_params.units: 3–7 comma-separated letters from Letter Unit: Group 1 (model phase accepts 1–7)
launch_params.pool: optional extra letters the distractors may be drawn from (default: the unit set)
launch_params.passes: times each unit is presented (default 2; model 1)
launch_params.seed: optional unsigned 32-bit seed for a reproducible run
launch_params.hand: right | left (mirrors the chrome, Vision TR-14)
launch_params.lines: 1 | 0 (baseline guide lines on the letter cards)
launch_params.sfx: 1 | 0 (sound effects only; narration cannot be muted, Vision NA-4)
launch_params.return: optional URL to go to when the learner taps Done and no host is embedding the activity

target_skill: letter recognition from the spoken letter name among confusable letters (orthographic knowledge, recognition)

corpus_deviations.deviation: If a narration asset fails to load on a device, the player falls back to browser speechSynthesis (or caption text if none). The run's telemetry records narration_mode as tts, text or mixed so the session layer can discount it.
corpus_deviations.reason: resilience on school networks (PL-7); the intended path is the pre-generated Kokoro narration shipped with the activity

latency.note: measured from prompt onset; never displayed
